title: A skate game inspired by THUG (Update 1 of however many days it takes)
author: Brewgazer
selftext:
So this is more like update 1.5 I had spent some time last month working on some skate mechanics and getting the feeling of skating to feel smooth. I sat on the mechanics for a little while and saw people going crazy about opus 5.5 so I thought screw it id give it a go…. Holy shit I didn’t think it was gonna be this good. So I had this idea for a character and I’m pretty sure most can pickup on the inspiration for it. I then had opus connected to the blender mcp with some skills I was given from a friend for blender, it hit the character outta the ballpark with the reference photo I gave it. It did so good I asked it to make the animations now when I’m asking I’m not like “make an Ollie” I detail which foot and knee come up towards the body while which feet stay extended until the right time and then that leg shifts. It got them done stupid fast, I was nearing the end of my usage limits so I asked it to add a build a map feature where I can edit terrain and add buildings and things so I could build a legit map save it later and use it as the games map while then later implementing a feature for players to create parks to play with their friends. I need to fix the roads with the terrain and most likely buildings. I was up until 2am. I’m still tired. I have an idea for this game but at the same time throw some suggestions and I’ll reach out to you if I decide to implement something!  

Also the song is a homie of mine who is a producer. The game still needs sounds and music.
